//: What licence every Python package in the sidecar's locks is under.
straight from PyPI. `licence` and `note` are written BY HAND, because PyPI's licence metadata
is not reliable enough to normalise: pillow-heif declares BSD-3-Clause and classifies itself
GPLv2, numpy pastes its whole licence text into a one-line field, and 'BSD License' does not
say two-clause or three. Where the evidence was ambiguous the value was taken from the
project's own LICENSE file (or, where a project ships none, from the wheel PM installs) and
`licence` records the wheel AS INSTALLED. For a compiled package that is its own code AND
everything its win_amd64, macOS and manylinux x86_64 wheels bundle: auditwheel's <pkg>.libs/,
delocate's .dylibs/, delvewheel's DLLs, and code linked in statically. Read it from the wheels
whose hashes are in the locks, not from the project's metadata or its LICENSE alone.
When upstream's metadata moves, the stamp changes and the generator BLANKS `licence` rather
than carrying the old answer forward; it keeps the old answer and its note in `previous`, to
compare the new wheels against. `just sidecar-licences` then fails until a human looks.
PM does not ship these packages — pip fetches them onto the user's machine on first run — so
they are deliberately not in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, which covers what the installer conveys.

Every wheel compiles in OpenCV 5's built-in fonts: Rubik and Rubik Italic (OFL-1.1, OpenCV's modules/imgproc/fonts/Rubik_OFL.txt) and WenQuanYi Micro Hei (Apache-2.0, as its own name table says); what else each wheel bundles differs. macOS arm64: Homebrew's FFmpeg 7.1 built with --enable-gpl and --enable-version3 (GPL-3.0-or-later) with x264, x265, rubberband and vidstab (GPL-2.0-or-later), plus a long LGPL/MPL/permissive tail: nettle, gmp, libunistring, libidn2 and graphite2 offer LGPL or GPL (the LGPL side taken); gnutls is LGPL-2.1-or-later only; mbedcrypto Apache-2.0 taken; zstd BSD-3-Clause taken (over GPL-2.0-only); libb2 Apache-2.0 taken (over CC0-1.0 and OpenSSL); highway Apache-2.0 taken (over BSD-3-Clause); FreeType FTL taken; HarfBuzz MIT-Modern-Variant; libX11 MIT AND X11, libxcb X11, libXau and libXdmcp MIT-open-group (their COPYING files, as Fedora's SPDX review reads them); liblzma from xz 5.8 0BSD; zimg WTFPL; libvmaf BSD-2-Clause-Patent. Every x86_64 wheel links Intel IPP ICV statically (LicenseRef-Intel-ISSL: binary-only terms). Linux: FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1-or-later), OpenSSL 1.1.1k (OpenSSL; end-of-life upstream, unreachable from PM), OpenBLAS with its LAPACK (BSD-3-Clause, BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI), libgfortran and libquadmath. Windows: an FFmpeg DLL (LGPL-2.1-or-later) and OpenCV's built-in CLAPACK (BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI; 'Lapack: YES (Built-In libclapack)' in cv2's build information). PM uses OpenCV only through rapidocr for pixel work. The GPL, Intel and OpenSSL parts are allowed for this package alone (PACKAGE_EXCEPTIONS in scripts/check-sidecar-licences.mjs, Bobby 2026-11-06: accept now, look for a swap). The fonts' OFL-1.1 is on the general allow-list (Bobby 2026-11-06).
